title: Ish joyida hamkasblar bilan muloqot
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz inglizcha ofis muhitida ishonch bilan muloqot qila olasiz: small talk boshlash va davom ettirish, yordam so‘rash va taklif qilish, vazifa va muddatni aniqlashtirish, muloyim norozilik bildirish va muqobil taklif berish, status update va feedback berish, ‘yo‘q’ni muloyim aytish hamda Slack xabarlari yozish.
homework_uz: To‘rtta rol o‘ynash: (1) ertalabki small talk, (2) hamkasbdan yordam so‘rash, (3) vazifa va deadline’ni aniqlashtirish, (4) muloyim norozilik bildirish. Har bir vaziyatni ovoz chiqarib o‘ynang yoki yozib oling; har vaziyatda kamida bitta aniqlashtirish savoli va muloyim formuladan foydalaning; gaplaringizni darsdagi namunalar bilan solishtirib, xatolarini to‘g‘rilang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: to‘rt vaziyatning har biri 30–60 soniya va formulalar tabiiy eshitilsin. Keyingi dars: P1-04 Telefon va video qo‘ng‘iroqlar.

vocab.uz: yengil norasmiy suhbat (havo, dam olish kunlari)
'Bir oz kuting, tekshirib ko‘raman' degan ibora

scenes.title: Ofisda inglizcha muloqotga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda rezyumeni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa ishga kirgandan keyin keladigan kundalik muloqot haqida. Yaxshi ingliz tilini bilsangiz ham, ofisda gaplashish qiyin: ohang, muloyim formulalar, aniqlashtirish — bularning barchasi o‘rganiladi. Dars oxirida siz small talk’dan muloyim norozilik bildirishgacha bo‘lgan ko‘nikmalarga ega bo‘lasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last lesson: the resume. Today: everyday office communication — tone, polite formulas, clarifying. By the end you'll handle office situations in natural professional English.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda rezyumeni o‘rgandik. Bugun ishga kirganingizdan keyin keladigan kundalik muloqot haqida. Yaxshi ingliz tilini bilsangiz ham, ofisda gaplashish qiyin — ohang, muloyim formulalar, aniqlashtirish. Dars oxirida siz small talk’dan muloyim norozilik bildirishgacha bo‘lgan ko‘nikmalarga ega bo‘lasiz.

scenes.title: Ohang va registr: ofisda qanday gaplashish

examples.t: Could you send me the file when you get a chance?

scenes.say_native: Ofisda registr — neytral-do‘stona: norasmiy, lekin hurmatli. 'Hi' va 'Could you...' ishlaydi; 'Hey, send it' juda qo‘pol, rasmiy 'Dear Colleague' esa noqulay. Hazil faqat ishonchli munosabatda; yangi hamkasbda urinmang. 'Please' va 'thanks' hech qachon ortiqcha emas — ular munosabatni moylaydi.
scenes.say: Office register is neutral-friendly: informal yet respectful. 'Hi' and 'Could you...' work; 'Hey, send it' is rude. Jokes only in trusted relationships. Please and thanks are never too much.
scenes.say_uz: Ofisda registr neytral-do‘stona: norasmiy, lekin hurmatli. 'Hi' va 'Could you...' ishlaydi; 'Hey, send it' qo‘pol, 'Dear Colleague' noqulay. Hazil faqat ishonchli munosabatda — yangi hamkasbda urinmang. Please va thanks hech qachon ortiqcha emas.

scenes.title: Small talk: mavzular va taqiqlari
board: Yaxshi: havo, sport, dam olish kunlari, tushlik
Yomon: siyosat, maosh, din, shaxsiy hayot

examples.t: How was your weekend? — How about yours?
examples.uz: Dam olish kunlaringiz qanday o‘tdi? — O‘zingizniki-chi?

scenes.say_native: Small talk — ofis yog‘i. Xavfsiz mavzular: havo, sport, dam olish kunlari, tushlik joyi, yaqindagi ta’til. Taqiqlangan mavzular: siyosat, maosh, din, sog‘liq, shaxsiy munosabatlar. Small talk’ning formulasi: savol bering, javobni eshiting, o‘zingiz ham qisqa javob bering, keyin ishga qayting. Ikki-uch jumla yetadi — uzoq emas, samimiy.
scenes.say: Small talk is office oil. Safe topics: weather, sport, weekends, lunch, holidays. Off-limits: politics, salary, religion, health, private life. Formula: ask, listen, answer briefly, return to work. Two or three sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Small talk — ofis yog‘i. Xavfsiz mavzular: havo, sport, dam olish kunlari, tushlik, yaqindagi ta’til. Taqiqlangan: siyosat, maosh, din, sog‘liq, shaxsiy munosabatlar. Formula: savol bering, eshiting, o‘zingiz javob bering, ishga qayting. Ikki-uch jumla yetadi.

scenes.title: Namuna: dushanba ertalabki small talk
scenes.say_native: Namuna small talk’ni tinglang. Kamola va Jasur dushanba ertalab uchrashadi. Kamola dam olish kunlarini so‘raydi, Jasur qisqa javob beradi va o‘zi ham so‘raydi; keyin tabiiy ko‘prik bilan ishga qaytadilar. E’tibor bering: hech kim chuqur shaxsiy mavzuga kirmaydi, savollar ikki tomonlama va ohang yengil.
scenes.say: Kamola: Morning! Good weekend? Jasur: Not bad — we hiked in the mountains on Saturday. You? Kamola: Pretty quiet, mostly reading and meal prep. Jasur: Sounds perfect. Anyway, did you get the report I sent on Friday? Kamola: Yes, I'll review it this morning — thanks for sending it. Jasur: Great. Let's sync at eleven.
scenes.say_uz: Kamola: Ertalab xayr! Dam olish kunlaringiz yaxshi o‘tdimi? Jasur: Yomon emas — shanba kuni tog‘da sayr qildik. O‘zingizniki? Kamola: Sokin o‘tdi, ko‘proq o‘qidim va ovqat tayyorladim. Jasur: Zo‘r tuyuladi. Mayli, juma kuni yuborgan hisobotimni olgandingizmi? Kamola: Ha, ertalab ko‘rib chiqaman — yuborganingiz uchun rahmat. Jasur: Ajoyib. Soat o‘n birdan keyin suhbatlashamiz.

scenes.title: Small talk mashqi: dam olish kunlari
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz small talk mashq qiling. Ovoz chiqarib ayting: 'How was your weekend?' — javob bering va 'How about yours?' deb so‘rang. Oxirida ishga qaytadigan ko‘prik qo‘shing: 'Anyway, did you see the update on...?'. Yigirma besh soniyada uch bosqichni bosib o‘ting: salom, savol, ko‘prik.
scenes.say: Practise your own small talk aloud. 'How was your weekend?' — answer briefly, then 'How about yours?' Close with a bridge back to work: 'Anyway, did you see the update on…?' Twenty-five seconds, three steps: greeting, question, bridge.
scenes.say_uz: Endi o‘zingiz small talk mashq qiling. Ovoz chiqarib ayting: 'How was your weekend?' — javob bering va 'How about yours?' deb so‘rang. Oxirida ko‘prik qo‘shing: 'Anyway, did you see the update on…?' Yigirma besh soniyada uch bosqich: salom, savol, ko‘prik.

scenes.title: Yordam so‘rash: muloyim formulalar

examples.t: Could you help me with the report format?

scenes.say_native: Yordam so‘rashda to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri 'Help me' demang. Ishlating: 'Could you help me with…?' — standart muloyim; 'I need a hand with…' — norasmiroq; 'Would you mind taking a look at…?' — eng muloyim. Har doim sababini qo‘shing: 'Could you check the numbers? The client is waiting.' Sababli so‘rovga rad etish qiyinroq va javob tezroq.
scenes.say: Never say just 'Help me'. Use 'Could you help me with…?' as the standard polite form; 'I need a hand with…' is more casual; 'Would you mind taking a look at…?' is the most polite. Always give a reason: 'Could you check the numbers? The client is waiting.' Reasons get faster yes.
scenes.say_uz: Yordam so‘rashda 'Help me' demang. Standart muloyim shakl: 'Could you help me with…?'; norasmiyroq: 'I need a hand with…'; eng muloyim: 'Would you mind taking a look at…?'. Har doim sababini ayting: 'Could you check the numbers? The client is waiting.' Sababli so‘rovga javob tezroq.

scenes.title: Yordam taklif qilish: 'Let me help'

examples.t: Do you want a hand with those slides?

scenes.say_native: Hamkasbingiz qiynalayotganini ko‘rsangiz, o‘zingiz taklif qiling. 'Let me help you with…' — bevosita; 'Do you want a hand?' — yengil; 'Happy to help if you're stuck' — ishonchli, bosimsiz. Taklif qiling, majburlamang: odam rad etsa, 'No worries' deb qabul qiling va yana jim ishga qayting. Qo‘pol taklif hurmatni buzadi.
scenes.say: See a colleague struggling? Offer first. 'Let me help you with…' is direct; 'Do you want a hand?' is light; 'Happy to help if you're stuck' is confident and unpressured. Offer, don't push: if refused, accept with 'No worries' and get back to work. A pushy offer erodes respect.
scenes.say_uz: Hamkasbingiz qiynalayotganini ko‘rsangiz, o‘zingiz taklif qiling. 'Let me help you with…' bevosita; 'Do you want a hand?' yengil; 'Happy to help if you're stuck' ishonchli, bosimsiz. Taklif qiling, majburlamang: rad etsa, 'No worries' bilan qabul qiling.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: ertalabki ofis suhbati va yordam
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash — dushanba ertalab ofisda. Jasur loyiha prezentatsiyasiga tayyorlanmoqda va slaydlardagi raqamlar bo‘yicha yordam so‘raydi. Kamola yordam berishga rozi bo‘ladi, keyin o‘ziga ish qoldig‘ini ham aytib o‘tadi. Diqqat bilan tinglang — savollar keyingi sahifada keladi.
scenes.say: Kamola: Morning! Good weekend? Jasur: Decent. Listen, I'm prepping the QBR slides and I need a hand with the revenue numbers. Kamola: Sure — what do you have? Jasur: The draft is in the shared folder; the growth chart looks off. Kamola: Let me take a look — ten minutes. Jasur: You're a lifesaver. Kamola: No problem — could you review my budget summary after? It's due tomorrow. Jasur: Absolutely — send it over.
scenes.say_uz: Kamola: Ertalab xayr! Dam olish kunlaringiz yaxshi o‘tdimi? Jasur: Mayli. Qara, QBR slaydlarini tayyorlayapman va daromad raqamlarida yordam kerak. Kamola: Albatta — hozir nimangiz bor? Jasur: Qoralama umumiy papkada. O‘sish grafigi noto‘g‘ri ko‘rinadi. Kamola: Ko‘rib chiqaman. O‘n daqiqa bering. Jasur: Siz qutqaradigan odamsiz. Kamola: Muammo emas. Aytgancha, mening byudjet xulosamni ko‘rib chiqa olasizmi? Ertaga topshiriladi. Jasur: Albatta — tayyor bo‘lgach yuboring.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
board: 4 Kamola javobida qanday o‘z ishini ham eslatadi?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: Jasur nima uchun yordam so‘raydi? Ikki: muammo qaysi faylda va qaysi qismida? Uch: Kamola o‘ziga qancha vaqt so‘raydi? To‘rt: Kamola javobida o‘z ishining qaysi qismini ham eslatadi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting — raqamlar va ismlar eng muhim detallar, keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: why does Jasur ask for help? Two: which file and which part is the problem in? Three: how much time does Kamola ask for? Four: what does Kamola in turn ask Jasur to review? Say the answers in your head — we check next.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: Jasur nima uchun yordam so‘raydi? Ikki: muammo qaysi faylda va qaysi qismida? Uch: Kamola qancha vaqt so‘raydi? To‘rt: Kamola o‘z ishining qaysi qismini Jasurga eslatadi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: Jasur QBR slaydlaridagi daromad raqamlari uchun yordam so‘radi. Ikki: muammo umumiy papkadagi slaydlarning o‘sish grafigida edi. Uch: Kamola o‘n daqiqa so‘radi. To‘rt: Kamola o‘zining byudjet xulosasini ko‘rib chiqishni Jasurdan so‘radi — yordam olgan odam, iymonli yordamni qaytardi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: he needed help with the revenue numbers for the QBR slides. Two: the problem was the growth chart in the shared-folder deck. Three: Kamola asked for ten minutes. Four: in return she asked Jasur to review her budget summary — help asked, help reciprocated.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: QBR slaydlari uchun daromad raqamlari. Ikki: umumiy papkadagi slaydlar — o‘sish grafigi. Uch: o‘n daqiqa. To‘rt: Kamola o‘zining byudjet xulosasini ko‘rib chiqishni Jasurdan so‘radi — yordam olgan odam iymonli yordamni qaytardi.

scenes.title: Vazifani aniqlashtirish: 5 ta savol

examples.t: So the report is due Friday — is that right?

scenes.say_native: Noma’lum vazifani olmang — avval aniqlashtiring. Besh savol: 'So you need…, is that right?' — tushunganingizni tekshiradi; 'What's the deadline?' — muddatni; 'What does done look like?' — yakuniy ko‘rinishni; 'Who else is involved?' — mas’uliyatlarni; 'Any format I should follow?' — formatni. Aniqlashtirish zaiflik emas, professionallik belgisi.
scenes.say: Never take a vague task — clarify first. 'So you need…, is that right?' checks understanding; 'What's the deadline?' the time; 'What does done look like?' the finish line; 'Who else is involved?' ownership; 'Any format I should follow?' the template. Clarifying is professionalism.
scenes.say_uz: Noma’lum vazifani olmang — avval aniqlashtiring. Besh savol: 'So you need…, is that right?' — tushunganingizni tekshiradi; 'What's the deadline?' — muddat; 'What does done look like?' — yakuniy ko‘rinish; 'Who else is involved?' — mas’uliyatlar; 'Any format I should follow?' — format. Aniqlashtirish — professionallik.

scenes.title: Deadline: so‘rash, tasdiqlash, cho‘zish
board: 'Can we push the deadline to Friday?'

examples.t: Can we push the report to Friday afternoon?

scenes.say_native: Muddat haqida uch belgi. Bir: so‘rang — 'When is this due?' Ikki: tasdiqlang — o‘zingiz aniq sanani takrorlang: 'So I'll deliver by Thursday noon — correct?'. Uch: cho‘zish kerak bo‘lsa, ochiq ayting: 'Can we push the deadline to Friday? I need one more day for validation.' Sabab va yangi sana bilan cho‘zish kuchliroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Three beats on deadlines. One, ask — 'When is this due?' Two, confirm by repeating the exact date — 'So by Thursday noon, correct?' Three, when extending: 'Can we push the deadline to Friday? I need one more day for validation.' A reason plus a new date is the strong way to extend.
scenes.say_uz: Muddat haqida uch belgi. Bir: so‘rang — 'When is this due?'. Ikki: tasdiqlang — sanani qaytaring: 'So I'll deliver by Thursday noon — correct?'. Uch: cho‘zish kerak bo‘lsa, ochiq ayting: 'Can we push the deadline to Friday? I need one more day for validation.' Sabab va yangi sana bilan cho‘zish kuchliroq.

scenes.title: Namuna: vazifani aniqlashtirish dialogi
scenes.say_native: Namuna dialogda Diyor aniqlashtirish savollarini beradi: vazifa doirasi, muddati va formati. Menejer aniq javob beradi va oxirida ikkisi ham bir xil natijani takrorlaydi. Bu — noto‘g‘ri tushunishlarning oldini oladigan professional odat. Har bir noma’lum vazifa shunday boshlansin.
scenes.say: Manager: Diyor, could you pull the churn numbers for last quarter? Diyor: Sure. Churn by cohort, or the overall rate? Manager: Monthly cohorts, overall at the end. Diyor: Got it. Deadline? Manager: Thursday noon. Diyor: Format — slide or spreadsheet? Manager: A spreadsheet is fine. Diyor: So — churn by cohort, spreadsheet, Thursday noon. Manager: Exactly.
scenes.say_uz: Menejer: Diyor, o‘tgan chorakning churn raqamlarini torta olasizmi? Diyor: Albatta. Churn’ni kohort bo‘yicha kerakmi yoki umumiy darajadanmi? Menejer: Oylik kohortlar, oxirida umumiy. Diyor: Tushundim. Muddat qachon? Menejer: Payshanba kun kuni. Diyor: Format — slayd yoki jadval? Menejer: Jadval yetadi. Diyor: Ajoyib — kohort bo‘yicha, jadval, payshanba kun kuni. Menejer: Aynan.

scenes.title: Aniqlashtirish mashqi: vazifa
board: 'So you need the report by Friday — correct?'
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz aniqlashtirish mashqini bajaring. Ovoz chiqarib ayting: vazifani tushunganingizni takrorlang, doirasini chegarcha savol bering, muddatini va formatini so‘rang. Oxirida hamma narsani bir jumlada yigma: 'So — churn by cohort, spreadsheet, Thursday noon.' Og‘zaki yig‘mach bu tushunishni mustahkamlaydi.
scenes.say: Now practise aloud. Repeat the task to confirm understanding, ask one scoping question, then deadline and format. Finish by sealing it in one sentence: 'So — churn by cohort, spreadsheet, Thursday noon.' Saying it back locks in shared understanding.
scenes.say_uz: Endi o‘zingiz mashq qiling. Vazifani tushunganingizni takrorlang, doirasini chegarcha savol bering, muddat va formatni so‘rang. Oxirida bir jumlada yigma: 'So — churn by cohort, spreadsheet, Thursday noon.' Og‘zaki yig‘mach tushunishni mustahkamlaydi.

scenes.title: Muloyim norozilik: 5 ta formula
board: 'I'm not sure that's the best approach...'

examples.t: I see your point, but have we considered the cost?
examples.uz: Fikringizni tushunaman, ammo xarajatni hisobga oldikmi?

scenes.say_native: Norozilik bildirish kerak — muloyim bildirish kerak. Besh formula: 'I see your point, but…' — tan olib qarshi chiqadi; 'I'm not sure that's the best approach…' — yumshoq shubha; 'I might be wrong, but…' — o‘zingizga ham shubha qoldiradi; 'Have we considered…?' — savol orqali e’tiroz; 'I share the goal, but I'd suggest…' — umumiy maqsadni urg‘ulaydi.
scenes.say: Five formulas: 'I see your point, but…' acknowledges then counters; 'I'm not sure that's the best approach…' is a soft doubt; 'I might be wrong, but…' leaves room; 'Have we considered…?' objects via a question; 'I share the goal, but I'd suggest…' anchors on the shared aim.
scenes.say_uz: Norozilik bildirish kerak — muloyim bildirish kerak. Besh formula: 'I see your point, but…' — tan olib, qarshi chiqadi; 'I'm not sure that's the best approach…' — yumshoq shubha; 'I might be wrong, but…' — o‘zingizga ham shubha qoldiradi; 'Have we considered…?' — savol orqali e’tiroz; 'I share the goal, but I'd suggest…' — umumiy maqsadni urg‘ulaydi.

scenes.title: Muqobil taklif: 'What if...?' va 'How about...?'

examples.t: What if we tested it with one team first?
examples.uz: Avval bitta jamoa bilan sinab ko‘rsak-chi?

scenes.say_native: Norozilikning eng kuchli shakli — norozilik + muqobil taklif. Faqat 'yo‘q' demang, 'yo‘q, balki...' deying. 'What if we tried…?' — sinov taklifi; 'How about splitting the work?' — bo‘lishish; 'One alternative could be…' — rasmiy variant. Bu formula hamkorlik kayfiyatini saqlaydi va suhbatni oldinga suradi.
scenes.say: The strongest form of disagreement is disagreement plus an alternative. Never just 'no' — say 'no, but rather…'. 'What if we tried…?' proposes a test; 'How about splitting the work?' proposes sharing; 'One alternative could be…' is the formal variant. This keeps the collaborative mood and moves the conversation forward.
scenes.say_uz: Norozilikning eng kuchli shakli — norozilik + muqobil taklif. Faqat 'yo‘q' demang, 'yo‘q, balki…' deying. 'What if we tried…?' — sinov taklifi; 'How about splitting the work?' — bo‘lishish; 'One alternative could be…' — rasmiy variant. Bu hamkorlik kayfiyatini saqlaydi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: jamoa muhokamasida bahs
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — jamoa yig‘ilishida bahsli muhokama. Kamola yangi CRM’ga o‘tishni taklif qiladi, Diyor xarajat va o‘rganish vaqti uchun xavotir bildiradi. Manager muloyim norozilik formulalaridan va 'What if' taklifidan foydalanib murosa taklif qiladi. Diqqat bilan tinglang — keyingi sahifada savollar kutib turadi.
scenes.say: Kamola: We should migrate to the new CRM this quarter — the old one crashes weekly. Diyor: I see your point, but migration costs two hundred engineering hours. What if we tested it with one team first? Kamola: Fair. A pilot with Sales? Diyor: One month, then we decide. Manager: I like it. Kamola — pilot plan by Friday; Diyor — scope hours. Both: On it.
scenes.say_uz: Kamola: Menimcha, shu chorakda yangi CRM’ga o‘tishimiz kerak — eskisi har hafta buziladi. Diyor: Fikringizni tushunaman, ammo migratsiya ikki yuz soat muhandislik vaqtini oladi. Avval bitta jamoa bilan sinab ko‘rsak-chi? Kamola: Adolatli. Sales bilan pilot bo‘lsa-chi? Diyor: Ha — bir oy, keyin qaror qilamiz. Manager: Menga yoqdi. Kamola, juma kunigacha pilot rejasini tuzing; Diyor, shu jamoaga kerakli soatlarni hisoblang. Ikkovi: Boshlaymiz.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: Kamola nimani taklif qiladi va nima uchun? Ikki: Diyor qanday xavotir bildiradi — qaysi raqamni aytadi? Uch: Diyor qanday muqobil taklif beradi? To‘rt: Manager qanday yakuniy qarorni e’lon qiladi va kim nimaga mas’ul? Javoblarni ichingizda tartib bilan qayd eting — keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what does Kamola propose and why? Two: what concern does Diyor raise — which number does he mention? Three: what alternative does Diyor propose? Four: what final decision does the manager announce, and who owns what? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: Kamola nimani taklif qiladi va nima uchun? Ikki: Diyor qanday xavotir bildiradi — qaysi raqamni aytadi? Uch: Diyor qanday muqobil taklif beradi? To‘rt: manager qanday yakuniy qaror qiladi va kim nimaga mas’ul? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
board: 1. Yangi CRM — eskisi har hafta buziladi
4. Sales bilan 1 oylik pilot; Kamola reja, Diyor soatlar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: Kamola yangi CRM’ga o‘tishni taklif qildi, chunki eski tizim har hafta buziladi. Ikki: Diyor ikki yuz soat muhandislik vaqti ketishini aytdi. Uch: muqobil — avval bitta jamoa bilan pilot qilish. To‘rt: Manager qaror qildi — Sales bilan bir oylik pilot; Kamola reja yozadi, Diyor soatlarini hisoblaydi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: Kamola proposed migrating to the new CRM — the old one crashes weekly. Two: Diyor flagged two hundred engineering hours. Three: the alternative — a pilot with one team first. Four: the manager decided on a one-month Sales pilot; Kamola drafts the plan, Diyor scopes the hours.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: yangi CRM — eskisi har hafta buziladi. Ikki: ikki yuz soat muhandislik vaqti. Uch: avval bitta jamoa bilan pilot. To‘rt: Sales bilan bir oylik pilot; Kamola reja yozadi, Diyor soatlarini hisoblaydi.

scenes.title: Status update: 'keep you in the loop'
board: 'Just to keep you in the loop...'

examples.t: Quick update: the report is 80% done, on track for Thursday.
examples.uz: Qisqa yangilanish: hisobot 80% tayyor, payshanbaga yetadi.

scenes.say_native: Status update — xavotirni oldini olish vositasi. Uch jumla yetadi: nima qildingiz, nima qoldi, qachon tugaydi. Boshlang: 'Just to keep you in the loop…' yoki 'Quick update on…'. Bloklovchi bo‘lsa, ochiq ayting: 'One blocker: waiting on design sign-off.' Sukstlik xavotir tug‘diradi, qisqa xabar ishonch tug‘diradi.
scenes.say: Status update = three sentences: what you did, what remains, when it lands. Open with 'Just to keep you in the loop…' or 'Quick update on…'. If blocked, say it plainly: 'One blocker: waiting on design sign-off.' Silence breeds anxiety; a short message breeds trust.
scenes.say_uz: Status update xavotirni oldini oladi. Uch jumla: nima qildingiz, nima qoldi, qachon tugaydi. 'Just to keep you in the loop…' yoki 'Quick update on…' deb boshlang. Bloklovchi bo‘lsa: 'One blocker: waiting on design sign-off.' Sukstlik xavotir tug‘diradi, qisqa xabar ishonch.

scenes.title: Feedback berish: muloyim formulalar

examples.t: One thing that might help: add an executive summary on page one.
examples.uz: Yordam beradigan bir narsa: birinchi sahifaga qisqa xulosa qo‘shing.

scenes.say_native: Feedback — sovg‘adir, lekin qadoqlanishi kerak. Ijobiy narsadan boshlang, taklifni muloyim bering, hurmat bilan yakunlang: 'Could I suggest adding…?' yoki 'One thing that might help is…'. Buyruq bermang: 'Add a summary!' — qo‘pol. Savol shaklida ham aytsangiz bo‘ladi: 'What do you think about a summary up top?'
scenes.say: Feedback is a gift — but it needs wrapping. Open with something positive, make the suggestion politely, close with respect: 'Could I suggest adding…?' or 'One thing that might help is…'. Never command: 'Add a summary!' is rude. You can even ask: 'What do you think about a summary up top?'
scenes.say_uz: Feedback — sovg‘a, lekin qadoqlanish kerak. Ijobiy narsadan boshlang, taklifni muloyim bering: 'Could I suggest adding…?' yoki 'One thing that might help is…'. Buyruq bermang — 'Add a summary!' qo‘pol. Savol shaklida ham aytsangiz bo‘ladi: 'What do you think about a summary up top?'

scenes.title: Feedback mashqi: qisqa taklif
scenes.say_native: O‘zingiz feedback mashqini bajaring. Avval hamkasbning ishini bitta ijobiy jumla bilan boshlang, keyin 'Could I suggest…?' formatida taklif bering, oxirida hurmat bilan yakunlang: 'But overall it's solid work.' Yigirma besh soniya yetadi — feedback sovg‘adir, lekin qadoqlanishi kerak.
scenes.say: Practise feedback aloud. Open with one genuine positive about your colleague's work, then a 'Could I suggest…?' line, and close with respect: 'But overall it's solid work.' Twenty-five seconds — no lecture needed.
scenes.say_uz: Ovoz chiqarib mashq qiling: bitta samimiy ijobiy jumla, keyin 'Could I suggest…?' taklif va hurmatli yakun: 'But overall it's solid work.' Yigirma besh soniya yetadi — uzun nutq shart emas.

scenes.title: Muloyim 'yo‘q': 'I'd love to, but...'
board: 'I'd love to, but I'm tied up with...'
'I can do it next week instead'

examples.t: I'd love to help, but I'm tied up with the audit. Next week?
examples.uz: Yordam berishni xohlayman, lekin audit bilan bandman. Keyingi hafta bo‘ladimi?

scenes.say_native: Yo‘q deyishni o‘rganmasangiz, barcha tarmoqlar yuqoriga tushadi. Muloyim 'yo‘q'ning formulasi: shakl — 'I'd love to, but…' yoki 'I wish I could, but…'; sabab — '…I'm tied up with the audit'; muqobil — '…next week instead?'. Sababsiz 'No' quruq va sovuq eshitiladi; sabab va muqobil bilan aytilgan 'yo‘q' hurmatni saqlaydi.
scenes.say: If you can't say no, everything piles up. The polite no formula: form — 'I'd love to, but…' or 'I wish I could, but…'; reason — '…I'm tied up with the audit'; alternative — '…next week instead?' A bare no sounds cold; a no with reason and alternative keeps the respect.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘q deyishni o‘rgansangiz, hamma narsa ustingizga tushmaydi. Muloyim 'yo‘q' formulasi: shakl — 'I'd love to, but…'; sabab — '…I'm tied up with the audit'; muqobil — '…next week instead?'. Sababsiz no quruq eshitiladi; sabab va muqobil bilan hurmat saqlanadi.

scenes.title: Muloyim 'yo‘q' mashqi
scenes.say_native: Endi muloyim 'yo‘q'ni mashq qiling. Holat: hamkasbingiz dam olish kunida yordam so‘raydi. 'I'd love to, but…' bilan boshlang, sabab ayting va muqobil sana taklif qiling. Yigirma soniyada ayting — rad etish ham muloyim, aniq, hurmatli bo‘lsin va sababingizni tan olib ayting.
scenes.say: Practise the polite no. Scenario: a colleague asks for help over the weekend. Start with 'I'd love to, but…', give a reason, offer an alternative date. Twenty seconds — calm, respectful and clear.
scenes.say_uz: Muloyim 'yo‘q'ni mashq qiling. Holat: hamkasbingiz dam olish kunida yordam so‘raydi. 'I'd love to, but…' bilan boshlang, sabab ayting, muqobil sana taklif qiling. Yigirma soniyada, xotirjam va hurmat bilan ayting.

scenes.title: Status iboralari: 'I'm on it' va 'Bear with me'

examples.t: I'm on it — I'll get back to you by 5 pm.

scenes.say_native: Ishda tez chiqadigan to‘rt ibora. 'I'm on it' — vazifani qabul qildingiz va boshladingiz; 'Bear with me' — bir daqiqa kuting, tekshiraman; 'I'll get back to you by…' — aniq vaqt bilan javob va’da qilasiz; 'Let me check and revert' — avval ma’lumotni tekshiraman, keyin javob beraman. Bu iboralar diplomatik va ishonchli ishlaydi.
scenes.say: Four workhorse phrases. 'I'm on it' — you've taken it and started; 'Bear with me' — give me a moment, I'll check; 'I'll get back to you by…' — you commit to a specific time; 'Let me check and revert' — I need to verify first, then answer. These carry diplomatic professionalism.
scenes.say_uz: Ishda tez chiqadigan to‘rt ibora. 'I'm on it' — qabul qildingiz va boshladingiz; 'Bear with me' — bir daqiqa kuting, tekshiraman; 'I'll get back to you by…' — aniq vaqt bilan javob va’da qilasiz; 'Let me check and revert' — avval tekshirib, keyin javob beraman.

scenes.title: Thanking: 'Thanks for...' va 'Much appreciated'

examples.t: Thanks for the quick turnaround on this.

scenes.say_native: Minnatdorchilik — ishonch kapitalining asosi. 'Thanks for the quick turnaround' — tez ish uchun; 'Much appreciated' — qisqa, professional; 'I really appreciate it' — samimiyroq; 'Thanks a lot' — norasmiyroq, do‘stlar bilan. Minnatdorchilik aytilmagan joyda jamoadoshlar 'u e’tibor bermaydi' deb o‘ylaydi — ayting, o‘z vaqtida ayting.
scenes.say: Gratitude is the currency of workplace trust. 'Thanks for the quick turnaround' — for fast work; 'Much appreciated' — short and professional; 'I really appreciate it' — more heartfelt; 'Thanks a lot' — casual, for friends. Where thanks goes unsaid, colleagues assume indifference — say it, and say it promptly.
scenes.say_uz: Minnatdorchilik — ishonch kapitalining asosi. 'Thanks for the quick turnaround' — tez ish uchun; 'Much appreciated' — qisqa, professional; 'I really appreciate it' — samimiyroq; 'Thanks a lot' — norasmiyroq. Aytilmagan joyda 'u e’tibor bermaydi' deb o‘ylashadi — ayting va o‘z vaqtida ayting.

scenes.title: Tabriklash: 'Congrats on...' va 'Well done'

examples.t: Congrats on the promotion — you've earned it.

scenes.say_native: Hamkasbning yutug‘ini ko‘rib, shunchaki 'good job' deyish — sinalgan va ishlagan ibora, lekin aniqroq aytsangiz, ta’sir ikki baravar. 'Congrats on the promotion — you've earned it.' 'Well done on the launch — the client loved it.' Tushunarli, samimiy va aniq: nima uchun tabriklayotganingizni ayting. Bu munosabatlarni mustahkamlaydi.
scenes.say: Saying just 'good job' works, but be specific and it lands twice as hard. 'Congrats on the promotion — you've earned it.' 'Well done on the launch — the client loved it.' Name the win: why you are congratulating. This builds the relationship.
scenes.say_uz: Shunchaki 'good job' desak, bo‘ladi — lekin aniqlashtirsangiz, ta’sir ikki baravar. 'Congrats on the promotion — you've earned it.' 'Well done on the launch — the client loved it.' Nima uchun tabriklayotganingizni ayting. Bu munosabatlarni mustahkamlaydi.

scenes.title: Slack: qisqa va aniq xabar yozish

examples.t: Hi @Diyor — quick q: is the deck ready for review?
examples.uz: Salom @Diyor — tez savol: deck ko‘rib chiqishga tayyormi?

scenes.say_native: Slack — chaqmoq emas, aniqlik talab qiladi. Birinchi qatorda nima kerakligini yozing: 'Hi @Diyor — deck tayyormi?'. Keyin kontekst: havola, fayl yoki qisqa tushuntirish. Savolingizni aniq qiling: 'Review qilishga ulgurasizmi?' — yopiq; 'When can you review?' — ochiq. Emojiylar yaxshi, lekin hissiyotni almashtirmang — ohangni yumshating, mazmunni emas.
scenes.say: Slack demands clarity, not brevity alone. First line: what you need — 'Hi @Diyor — deck ready for review?' Then context: link, file or one line of background. Make the question explicit — 'Can you review it?' is closed; 'When can you review?' is open. Emojis soften tone, never replace content.
scenes.say_uz: Slack — aniqlik talab qiladi. Birinchi qatorda nima kerakligini yozing: 'Hi @Diyor — deck tayyormi?' Keyin kontekst: havola, fayl yoki qisqa tushuntirish. Savolni aniq qiling: 'Can you review it?' — yopiq; 'When can?' — ochiq. Emoji ohangni yumshatadi, mazmunni almashtirmaydi.

scenes.title: Namuna: Slack xabarlari
scenes.say_native: Namuna Slack xabarlarini tinglang: biri so‘rov, biri status, biri minnatdorchilik. Uchchalasi ham uch qatordan oshmaydi: kimga, nima, qachon. Shunday uslubda yozsangiz, hamkasblaringiz sizni tez va professional deb biladi. O‘zingizning uslubingizga moslashtiring, lekin tuzilishini saqlang.
scenes.say: Hi @Kamola — could you review the QBR deck today? Deadline is 5 pm. Link: shared/qbr-final. Thanks! — Quick update: numbers are validated, two slides left to polish. On track for tomorrow noon. — Much appreciated for yesterday's help! Closing the loop: client approved the new design.
scenes.say_uz: Hi @Kamola — QBR deck’ni bugun ko‘rib chiqa olasizmi? Muddat 17:00. Havola: shared/qbr-final. Rahmat! — Qisqa yangilanish: raqamlar tekshirildi, ikki slayd qoldi. Ertaga kunning ikkinchisiga tayyor. — Kechagi yordamingiz uchun juda minnatdorman! Mijoz yangi dizaynni tasdiqladi.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha ongidan o‘tgan 5 xato
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekcha tartibdan o‘tgan besh xato. Bir: 'Do this quickly' — to‘g‘ridan buyruq; to‘g‘risi 'Could you do this by Thursday?'. Ikki: 'It is not good' — og‘ir va haqoratlangan holda eshitiladi; 'This could be stronger' deying. Uch: 'I want' o‘rniga 'Could I please…'. To‘rt: ruscha tartibda uzun gaplar o‘rniga qisqa anglashiladigan gaplar. Besh: minnatdorchilikni unutmang.
scenes.say: Five mistakes from the Uzbek mindset. One: 'Do this quickly' is a blunt command — say 'Could you do this by Thursday?'. Two: 'It is not good' lands hard — try 'This could be stronger'. Three: 'I want' becomes 'Could I please…?'. Four: long Russian-order sentences shrink into short clear ones. Five: never forget thanks.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbekcha ongdan o‘tgan besh xato. Bir: 'Do this quickly' — to‘g‘ridan buyruq; 'Could you do this by Thursday?' deying. Ikki: 'It is not good' og‘ir eshitiladi — 'This could be stronger' deying. Uch: 'I want' o‘rniga 'Could I please…'. To‘rt: ruscha tartibda uzun gaplar o‘rniga qisqa gaplar. Besh: minnatdorchilikni unutmang.

scenes.title: Xatolarni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Uchta qatorni muloyim holga keltiring. 'Do this quickly' → 'Could you do this by Thursday afternoon?'. 'It is not good' → 'This could be stronger — let me suggest…'. 'I want the report today' → 'Could I get the report by end of day?'. Har birida muloyim shakl + aniq vaqt. Ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Soften three lines. 'Do this quickly' → 'Could you do this by Thursday afternoon?' 'It is not good' → 'This could be stronger — let me suggest…' 'I want the report today' → 'Could I get the report by end of day?' Polite form plus a specific time, said aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta qatorni muloyimga keltiring: 'Do this quickly' → 'Could you do this by Thursday afternoon?'; 'It is not good' → 'This could be stronger — let me suggest…'; 'I want the report today' → 'Could I get the report by end of day?'. Muloyim shakl + aniq vaqt, ovoz chiqarib ayting.

scenes.title: Madaniyat farqlari: UK va US ohanglari
board: Small talk UK: ob-havo; US: sport/weekend

examples.t: 'Not bad at all' (UK) — aslida juda yaxshi.
examples.uz: UK'da 'not bad at all' — aslida juda yaxshi degani.

scenes.say_native: Ingliz tili bitta emas. UK ohangi understatement: 'not bad at all' aslida juda yaxshi degani; iltifotlar yumshoq. US ohangi ochiqroq: 'awesome', 'great job', to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri energiya. UK small talk'da ob-havo-sen — universal mavzu; US'da sport va dam olish kunlari. Hazil US'da tez va aniq, UK'da nozik va ironik. Ikkala madaniyatda xushmuomala bo‘ling, lekin nuance'ni biling.
scenes.say: English cultures differ. The UK runs on understatement — 'not bad at all' means genuinely good; politeness is soft. The US is open: 'awesome', direct energy. UK small talk leans on weather; the US on sport and weekends. US humour is quick; UK humour is dry. Be warm in both — just know the nuance.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tili bitta emas. UK ohangi understatement: 'not bad at all' aslida juda yaxshi; iltifotlar yumshoq. US ohangi ochiqroq: 'awesome', to‘g‘ridan energiya. UK small talk'da ob-havo, US'da sport va dam olish. US hazili tez, UK hazili nozik. Ikkalasida xushmuomala bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Tana tili va ovoz toni ishda
scenes.say_native: Muloqotning yarmi — og‘zaki emas. Tabassum va qisqa ko‘z muloqoti ishonch beradi. Ovozingizni tinch va shoshilmasdan chiqaring — tez, baland ovoz ofisda hissiyotli eshitiladi. Qo‘llaringizni ortiqcha izmolasiz, lekin tabiiy ishlating. 'Could you please…' deysiz-u, qoshingizni chimirsangiz yoki xo‘rsansangiz — muloyim so‘z muloyim emas tana tili bilan buziladi.
scenes.say: Half of communication is not verbal. A smile and brief eye contact signal ease. Voice calm and unhurried — fast and loud reads as emotional in an office. Use hands naturally, never theatrically. Say 'Could you please…' while frowning — and the polite words are undone.
scenes.say_uz: Muloqotning yarmi og‘zaki emas. Tabassum va qisqa ko‘z muloqoti ishonch beradi. Ovoz tinch, shoshilmasdan — tez, baland ovoz hissiyotli eshitiladi. Qo‘llarni tabiiy ishlating, teatr emas. 'Could you please…' deysiz-u, xo‘rsansangiz — muloyim so‘z muloyim bo‘lmay qoladi.

scenes.title: Rol o‘yini: 4 ta ofis vaziyati
scenes.say_native: To‘liq rol o‘yini. To‘rt vaziyatni ketma-ket ovoz chiqarib o‘ynang: bir, dushanba ertalabgi small talk — salom, savol, ko‘prik; ikki, hamkasbdan yordam so‘rash — Could you help me with…; uch, vazifani aniqlashtirish — So you need…, muddat qachon?; to‘rt, muloyim norozilik — I see your point, but…. Har biri o‘n besh soniya, umumiy qirq besh. Yozib oling va tinglang.
scenes.say: Full role-play, four scenarios aloud: one — Monday-morning small talk: greeting, question, bridge; two — ask a colleague for help: Could you help me with…; three — clarify a task: So you need…, by when?; four — polite disagreement: I see your point, but…. Fifteen seconds each, forty-five total. Record yourself and listen back.
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq rol o‘yini — to‘rt vaziyat, ovoz chiqarib: bir, dushanba small talk — salom, savol, ko‘prik; ikki, yordam so‘rash — Could you help me with…; uch, vazifani aniqlashtirish — So you need…, muddat qachon?; to‘rt, muloyim norozilik — I see your point, but…. Har biri o‘n besh soniya. Yozib oling, tinglang.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Ofisda small talk xavfsiz mavzularda — havo, dam olish — va ko‘prik bilan tugaydi. Yordam so‘rashda 'Could you help me with…', taklif qilishda 'Do you want a hand?'. Vazifani besh savol bilan aniqlashtiring va muddatni takrorlang. Norozilikni 'I see your point, but…' bilan boshlang va muqobil taklif qo‘shing. Status update uch jumla, feedback ijobiy + taklif, rahmat esa har doim.
scenes.say: Sum up. Small talk: safe topics, end with a bridge. Help: 'Could you help me with…' to ask, 'Do you want a hand?' to offer. Clarify with five questions, repeat the deadline. Disagree: 'I see your point, but…' plus an alternative. Update = three sentences; feedback = positive plus a suggestion; thanks always.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilamiz. Small talk xavfsiz mavzularda, ko‘prik bilan tugaydi. Yordam: 'Could you help me with…' — so‘rash, 'Do you want a hand?' — taklif. Besh savol bilan aniqlashtiring, muddatni takrorlang. Norozilik: 'I see your point, but…' + muqobil. Status update uch jumla; feedback = ijobiy + taklif; rahmat har doim.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Keyingi dars: Telefon va video qo‘ng‘iroqlar
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: to‘rtta qisqa ofis vaziyatini rol o‘ynang — ertalabki small talk, yordam so‘rash, vazifa va deadline’ni aniqlashtirish, muloyim norozilik bildirish. Har birida kamida bitta aniqlashtirish savoli va bitta muloyim formuladan foydalaning. O‘z ovozingizni yozib oling, tinglang, namuna bilan solishtiring. Keyingi darsda telefon va video qo‘ng‘iroqlarni o‘rganamiz — ochishdan ovozli xabar qoldirishgacha. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: role-play four office scenarios — morning small talk, asking for help, clarifying a task and deadline, polite disagreement. One clarifying question plus one polite formula in each. Record, listen back, compare with the samples. Next lesson: professional phone and video calls. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: to‘rtta qisqa ofis vaziyatini rol o‘ynang — ertalabki small talk, yordam so‘rash, vazifa va deadline’ni aniqlashtirish, muloyim norozilik. Har birida kamida bitta aniqlashtirish savoli va bitta muloyim formuladan foydalaning. Ovoz chiqarib yozib oling va namuna bilan solishtiring. Keyingi dars: telefon va video qo‘ng‘iroqlar. Omad tilayman!

quiz.q: Which is a safe small talk topic at work?
quiz.why_uz: Ob-havo va dam olish kunlari — xavfsiz, universal mavzular; maosh, siyosat va sog‘liq esa norasmiy muhitda ham noqulay va bahsli.

quiz.q: Which is the politest way to ask for help?
options: 'Could you help me with the report when you get a chance?'
quiz.why_uz: 'Could you help me with…' muloyim, aniq va hurmatli; buyruq ohanglari qo‘pol eshitiladi va munosabatni buzadi.

quiz.q: What does 'So you need the deck by Thursday — correct?' check?
options: That you understood the task correctly
quiz.why_uz: Takroorlash (read-back) — vazifani to‘g‘ri tushunganingizni tekshirishning eng ishonchli usuli; xatolar shu zahoti ochiladi.

quiz.q: Which is the best formula for polite disagreement?
options: 'I see your point, but have we considered the cost?'
quiz.why_uz: Avval tan olib, keyin e’tiroz bildirish — eng hurmatli va samarali norozilik; to‘g‘ridan 'wrong' deyish suhbatni yopadi.

quiz.q: What is the purpose of a status update?
options: To inform: what you did, what remains, when it lands
quiz.why_uz: Status update uch jumladan iborat: nima qildingiz, nima qoldi, qachon tugaydi — sukutdan ko‘ra qisqa xabar ishonch beradi.

quiz.q: How do you politely say no to a weekend favour?
options: 'I'd love to, but I'm tied up with the audit — how about Tuesday instead?'
quiz.why_uz: Shakl + sabab + muqobil — muloyim rad etishning to‘liq formulasi; xafa qilishsiz chegarani saqlaydi.

quiz.q: Which phrase means 'the job has started and I'm handling it'?
quiz.why_uz: 'I'm on it' — vazifani qabul qilib, boshlaganingizni bildiradi; qisqa, kuchli eshitiladigan ishonch signali.

quiz.q: What does 'keep someone in the loop' mean?
options: Lock them out of the project
quiz.why_uz: 'Keep in the loop' — kishini jarayon haqida xabardor qilib turish; status update'ning rasmiyroq nomi.

quiz.q: Which feedback formula is the most constructive?
options: 'Could I suggest adding a summary on page one?'
quiz.why_uz: Muloyim taklif — 'Could I suggest…' — ijobiy va samimiy feedback; buyruq va tanqid esa himoya reaksiyasini uyg‘otadi.

quiz.q: In the UK, 'not bad at all' most likely means...
quiz.why_uz: UK ohangi understatement: 'not bad at all' ko‘pincha 'juda yaxshi' degani; US ohangi esa ochiqroq ('awesome!').
